en.headline: Big C to close its Kolour Tsuen Wan store in early November
en.dek: The Thai supermarket chain confirmed the branch will shut after its lease ends, leaving the Tsuen Wan district without a Big C outlet for now.
body: Thai supermarket chain Big C said its store at Kolour Tsuen Wan will close in early November after the lease expires. Shelves have already been cleared as the outlet prepares to shut.

The company told reporters the last trading day would be in the first half of November. After the closure, Big C will have no branch in the Tsuen Wan district for the time being. It said it was looking for a more suitable location in the area to continue serving customers.

Big C entered the Hong Kong market in 2023 by acquiring the Abouthai chain and previously outlined plans to expand to 99 stores by the end of 2026. Official listings currently show 19 remaining branches excluding the Kolour outlet.
The group said it remained confident in the Hong Kong market and was preparing to launch an online store to offer more convenient shopping options.

zh.headline: Big C荃灣千色匯店11月上旬結業
zh.dek: 泰國連鎖超市確認荃灣千色匯分店因租約期滿將於11月上旬結束營業，荃灣區暫時再無Big C門市。
body: 泰國連鎖超市Big C表示，位於荃灣千色匯的分店將因租約期滿而於11月上旬結業。店內貨架已陸續清空，正進行搬遷清貨。
集團向傳媒證實，最後營業日為11月上旬。結業後，Big C在荃灣區暫時再無分店。公司指正積極物色更合適的位置，希望日後能繼續服務區內顧客。
Big C於2023年收購本地「阿布泰」連鎖店後進軍香港市場，曾公布目標於2026年底將分店增至99間。根據官方資料，不計千色匯店，目前全港約餘19間分店。
集團表示對香港市場仍有信心，並正籌備推出網上商店，以提供更便捷的購物選擇。
